title: Rounded rectangular body
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of eight curves. Begin with the first arc, starting at coordinates (0.0, 0.0025), passing through the midpoint (0.0007, 0.0007), and ending at (0.0025, 0.0). Follow this with the first line from (0.0025, 0.0) to (0.0575, 0.0). Next, draw the second arc starting at (0.0575, 0.0), with a midpoint at (0.0593, 0.0007), and ending at (0.06, 0.0025). Continue with the second line from (0.06, 0.0025) to (0.06, 0.0575). Then, draw the third arc starting at (0.06, 0.0575), with a midpoint at (0.0593, 0.0593), and ending at (0.0575, 0.06). Add the third line from (0.0575, 0.06) to (0.0025, 0.06). Next, draw the fourth arc starting at (0.0025, 0.06), with a midpoint at (0.0007, 0.0593), and ending at (0.0, 0.0575). Finally, complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0575) back to (0.0, 0.0025). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.06. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially set. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along its normal by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rounded rectangular body are 0.06 units in length, 0.06 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0, 0)

# Create the arcs and lines
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0025).threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0007), (0.0025, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0575, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0593, 0.0007), (0.06, 0.0025))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.06, 0.0575)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0593, 0.0593), (0.0575, 0.06))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0025, 0.06)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0593), (0.0, 0.0575))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0, 0.0025)

# Close the sketch
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Display the result
